austin.summary: Austin, you drafted last and somehow walked away with the two best players in the game. Eric at pick #16 and Carter at #15 are both sitting at 15 pts, rank 1 of 21, and they're both still in the game. That's the good news. The bad news wears a 2 draft GPA — Linnea and Jenna are long gone. You're rank 3 of 5 with 40 counted points, the leader has 59, and 32 points are still on the table. You're alive.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Eric, your pick #16 steal, is tied at the very top with 15 pts and a rank of 1 of 21 — the best value in this entire draft.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Jenna at pick #6 was the reach that stung, going out 4th in Ep 4 with 4 pts and a rank of 17 of 21, and Linnea followed her out the door in Ep 5.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Both of your survivors wear Tovuto buffs, so watch how that tribe holds together — your whole comeback runs through one camp.

kylie.summary: Kylie, you took the first punch of this draft — Aaliyah went home first, and that First Blood badge is yours forever. But look what you did with pick #8: Cristian is ranked 1 of 21, and he's your one still in the game out of 4. You're sitting at rank 4 of 5 with 33 counted points, eliminated from contention while the leader has 59. Still, 21 points are on the table. Play it out.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Cristian — 15 pts, rank 1 of 21, an A grade, and the steal of the draft at pick #8 — is single-handedly keeping this roster upright.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Your very first pick, Aaliyah at #3, was first voted out in Ep 1 for 0 pts and a rank of 21 of 21 — the definition of a reach.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: You peaked with +8 in Ep 7 and bottomed out with +1 in Ep 9, so watch whether Cristian can chase down those 21 remaining points and make this finish respectable.

tami.summary: Tami, you had first pick and you built a Tovuto fortress — Jelly, Mike, and Sharonda, all three still in the game, all three sitting at 15 pts. That's 48 counted points, rank 2 of 5, with the leader at 59 and 43 points still on the table. Your roster owns the hardware too: 2 necklaces, 2 found. Ep 7 gave you +12, Ep 4 gave you +3. You're right there. Dig in.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Sharonda — your leftover at pick #21 — grades out at A with 15 pts and ranks 1 of 21, the steal of this entire draft.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: A 2.4 draft GPA tells the story: Patt went at pick #10, ranks 18 of 21 with 3 pts and an F after going 3rd voted out, while Rob's 2 pts get dropped under best-4.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Whether Jelly, Mike, and Sharonda stay tight inside that Tovuto bloc or start turning on each other once the merge forces a choice.

taylor.summary: Taylor, you held the second pick and built a roster with real heart — a crisis manager, a hustler, a voice actress, and a pro wrestler. But the torches came fast: 0 of 4 still in the game, 31 counted points, rank 5 of 5, with the leader sitting on 59 and 0 points still on the table. A 1.25 draft GPA stings. Ep 7 gave you +7 and a glimmer; Ep 8 gave you +0. Head high — this crew went out swinging.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Kristin Flickinger led your four with 12 pts, rank 12 of 21, the oldest player out there outlasting the field until the jury phase.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Ana Sani's game ended on Day 5 in 20th place, leaving you just 1 pts from pick #12 — and your reach at #2, Kristin, finished ranked 12.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Your badges are the keepsakes now — Torch Collector with 4 torches snuffed and Idol Whisperer with 2 found — plus Brady at pick #19, rank 13, the steal that proves your eye still works.

tim.summary: Tim! From the fourth slot you built a fortress. Rank 1 of 5, 59 counted points, 3 of 4 still in the game, and a Merge Machine badge because every single name you called made it to the feast. Wire-to-Wire, too — you've led or co-led after every elimination. Ep 7 handed you +16, Ep 9 gave you just +3, and your crew has dug up 2 idols and advantages. 43 points still on the table.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: You've got a three-way tie at the top — Maggie, Devin, and Thien An all sitting at 15 pts and ranked 1 of 21 — with Thien An at pick #17 the steal of your entire draft.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Lewis went at pick #4 and finished as the 3rd jury member in Ep 9 with 14 pts, rank 10 of 21 and a grade D — that's the one swing that didn't connect.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Whether those three Tovuto survivors keep stacking together, because 43 points are still out there and the leader is at 59.
